en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘From the happiness of the man is that his daughter (does not) experience (her first) menses in his house’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from certain persons of his people who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is of the good fortune of a man whose daughter does not experience Hayd (menses) in his home.’”
